title: NYC Greenwich Village Food/Nightlife Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Taste your way through Greenwich Village on a fun, tips-based food tour packed with iconic bites, local stories, and neighborhood charm. Explore famous landmarks, hidden gems, and must-try food spots while discovering one of NYC’s most vibrant and historic areas.

Choose your own tastings along the way, from classic New York pizza and legendary falafel to a sweet bakery treat. With great photo stops, insider tips, and a relaxed local vibe, this is the perfect way to eat, walk, and experience the Village beyond the usual tourist route.

Reserve your spot and tip what you feel at the end.
